name: Vision of Voodress
label: Quest
description: Vision of Voodress: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You and Maywiki have something in common, mon. We both be shaman! Although, Maywiki is more of a mystic and you be more of a scrub. Still, we both know what the great spirits bring.
As a gift I give to you this orb to wear around your neck. Look deep inside and see the village of Voodress in the South Seas! Let it lift your spirits!
